summary: The diff adds global CSS overrides for Radix Sheet/Dialog overlay/content in frontend/src/index.css and adds mobile menu state handling in Header.tsx (close on navigation and on view activation), plus updates ViewActivationOverlay styling/stacking. Core intent of fixing transparency and preventing intermediate states appears addressed, but the z-index stacking requirement relative to the sticky header/menu button is not clearly satisfied because the overlay is forced to z-index 50 while the header is also z-50.

missing_requirements.requirement: The overlay/content stacking works correctly: header/menu button is not visually lost behind a transparent layer; the overlay sits above the app content and the sheet content sits above the overlay.
missing_requirements.reason: The global CSS forces the overlay to z-index: 50 and content to z-index: 51, but the Header component uses z-50 as well. With equal z-index between header and overlay, it is not evidenced that the overlay will consistently sit above the header/app content as required.
